mapper.select: SELECT l.loan_id AS loanId, l.loan_name AS loanName, l.loan_summary AS loanSummary, l.organization_name AS organizationName, l.interest_rate AS interestRate, l.loan_limit AS loanLimit FROM loans l, business_info bi WHERE bi.user_id = #{userId} AND ( (l.region_id IS NULL AND l.industry_id IS NULL) OR l.region_id = bi.region_id OR l.industry_id = bi.industry_id ) ORDER BY l.interest_rate ASC
